integrity: The proof derives the full linear covariance of the normalized section-width functional, computes the cube central-section area by an explicit plane parameterization and corner-triangle subtraction, and proves both extrema with exact algebra and AM-GM. A standalone checker independently reconstructs section polygons from edges and tests affine images; finite checks are not used as a proof of the continuum statement.
scientific_limitations: The exact 9/4 value is a three-dimensional parallelotope result. The affine covariance lemma is dimension-independent, but higher-dimensional cube optimization is not resolved here. The result is a benchmark for Busemann–Petty Problem 6, not a solution of the global minimax problem. The related 2023 article could be inspected only through its public abstract and bibliographic material, and unindexed equivalent computations remain a residual originality risk.
title: Exact Busemann–Petty section-width profile of three-dimensional parallelotopes
